text:
Ruby Alvarez: Hi everyone! Ruby here (she/they), starting today as a Product Marketing Engineer. Live in Oakland, commute to SF sometimes. Amateur photographer, plant parent (3 ferns and a stubborn succulent), and huge fan of spicy ramen. Excited to be here!
Nate Bloom: Welcome Ruby!! :tada: If you like spicy ramen, we have a group that rotates spots on Tuesdays. Also the office has a tiny photo wall  we'd love your contributions.
Facilities Bot: Welcome @Ruby Alvarez! You've been added to #new-hires and your welcome kit is scheduled for delivery. Please confirm t-shirt size and any dietary restrictions: https://redwood.company/welcome (automated)
Ruby Alvarez: Sent DM with size L and noted: severe allergy to sesame. Also, small ask: do we have a standing desk option in SF office? My back prefers it.
Lina Gomez: Hi Ruby  welcome! We do have adjustable desks, ping facilities and they'll book one for the days you're in office. Also FYI we keep a plant swap box in the lounge on the 3rd Friday of every month.
Nate Bloom: Also, if you ever want to borrow a camera lens for a weekend shoot, I'm happy to lend mine. We do a casual photo walk on the last Saturday of the month.
welcome-bot: Hi @Ruby  added to the "All Hands" calendar, #product-marketing, and the "Intro Lightning Talks" list. Your onboarding buddy is Nate Bloom.
Ruby Alvarez: Amazing, thanks! I can bring a small, peanut-free cake for the welcome meet on Friday. And I will absolutely take you up on that lens, Nate.
Lina Gomez: Noted: sesame allergy and peanut-free cake  appreciate the heads-up. Sent invite for Friday 11am welcome huddle and a desk booking for Wed/Thu.
Nate Bloom: Quick heads up: we have "quiet hours" from 2-3pm in the main area for focused work. Also meme channel is vibrant after 4pm if you need a laugh.
Ruby Alvarez: Quiet hours noted. Looking forward to the meme enlightenment and to meeting you all in person. Thanks for the warm welcome!
